summary: Two blind judges (opus, sonnet) give the article of 60 tagged chair, vote and procedural segments; a third (opus) on splits

opus.reason: Vote on Israeli amendment to original text of draft ICESCR article 15 (plan for compulsory primary education), mapped to final ICESCR 14.
Procedural decision to set up a Working Party on the amendments; no substantive content of its own.
Vote rejecting Pavlov amendment to draft Article 19 (assembly and association), which maps to UDHR 20.
Vote on second part of proposed new civil-covenant article 50 (Charter and specialized agencies' constitutions clause), matching final ICCPR 46.
Chair on USSR equal-pay amendment and New Zealand redraft of trade-union paragraph 3 of draft article 21, i.e. UDHR 23.
Decision to adjourn the draft resolution on the Committee's time for the Covenants; purely procedural.
Chair mainly on time-limits for amendments and rapporteur's role; only closes by reverting to article 37.
Chair reads draft Article 15 (legal personality composite, mapped to UDHR 6) and proposes deleting 'eventually' in its counsel clause.
Vote on trade-union words of UK amendment to paragraph 1 of draft article 16, mapped to ICCPR 22.
Roll-call vote on USSR amendment to paragraph 1 of draft article 10 (fair trial), mapped to ICCPR 14.

sonnet.reason: Vote on the Israeli amendment to the original text of draft ICESCR article 15, the plan for compulsory primary education, which maps to final ICESCR 14.
'It was so decided' sets up a Working Party to unify the amendments to article 6, the sole subject of the debate; the segment itself is bare procedure.
Rejection of the USSR amendment on denying assembly and association to fascists, in draft article 19 (assembly, association, trade unions), which maps to UDHR 20.
Second part of proposed ICCPR article 50, the counterpart of draft ICESCR 69, saving the specialized agencies' constitutions; this is final ICCPR 46.
The chair turns to the New Zealand redraft of paragraph 3 of draft article 21, the right to trade unions, after the equal-pay amendments; draft 21 maps to UDHR 23.
Adjournment of a draft resolution about time allocation for the Covenants at the next session; purely procedural.
The chair is mainly settling the time-limit for amendments to Part IV. His brief return to article 37 and the Belgian amendment is incidental.
Comment on the word 'eventually' in draft article 15 (legal personality, marriage, access to tribunals, counsel), which maps to UDHR 6; counsel could also fit fair trial.
Vote on the words 'including the right to form and join trade unions' in the UK amendment to paragraph 1 of draft article 16, freedom of association, which is final ICCPR 22.
Roll-call vote on the first sentence of the USSR amendment to paragraph 1 of draft article 10 (fair trial), which maps to final ICCPR 14.

third.reason: Decision to set up a Working Party on the amendments to draft article 6 (right to life), the meeting's only subject; procedural but article-specific.

opus.reason: '(continued)' completes the heading 'Article 10 of the draft Covenant on ESCR'; draft 10 maps to ICESCR 10; debate follows on it.
Chair calls vote on paragraph 1 of draft article 21 (work, equal pay); draft 21 maps to UDHR 23.
Attendance list and agenda title of the meeting; no article content.
Vote adopting sub-paragraph (c) of draft article 21 (working conditions); draft 21 maps to ICESCR 7.
Vote on first UK amendment to article 62 (specialized agencies' reports); draft 62 maps to ICESCR 18.
Chair sets the deadline for amendments to draft article 7 only; draft 7 maps to ICESCR 7; procedural but single-article.
Drafting change to paragraph 9 of education article (respect for parents' convictions, religious education); fits ICESCR 13(3).
Chair puts UK amendment to Declaration article 31 (free public education, resources clause) to vote; subject is UDHR 26.
Vote adopting Convention article 21 on accession (instrument of accession, paragraph 3 deleted); fits final clause ICCPR 48.
Vote adopting paragraph 2 of article 61 (reporting in stages); draft 61 maps to ICESCR 17.

sonnet.reason: Bare '(continued)' under the heading 'Article 10 of the draft Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights'; draft 10 maps to final ICESCR 10 (family, mothers, children).
Chair calls the vote on paragraph 1 of draft article 21 (right to work, equal pay); numbering maps draft 21 to UDHR 23.
List of members, observers and secretariat plus the general covenant title; no article content.
Vote on sub-paragraph (c) of draft ICESCR article 21 (minimum wage and working conditions debated just before); draft 21 maps to final ICESCR 7.
Vote on the first UK amendment to article 62 (specialized agencies' reports); draft 62 maps to final ICESCR 18.
Chair sets the time limit for amendments to article 7, just introduced and under discussion; draft 7 maps to ICESCR 7 (just conditions of work).
Wording amendment to paragraph 9 in the education article; Sweden's reply concerns parents' religious education outside the State Church, which fits the parents' liberty clause of ICESCR 13.
Chair puts the UK amendment to Article 31 of the draft Declaration (free education 'to the extent of the State's resources'); this is the education article, UDHR 26.
Vote on paragraphs 1-2 of Article 21 of the draft Convention, whose paragraph 3 concerns deposit of the instrument of accession; fits signature, ratification and accession (ICCPR 48).
Vote on paragraph 2 of article 61 (factors and difficulties preventing full implementation, in the reports); draft 61 maps to final ICESCR 17.

opus.reason: Vote on an oral amendment to a procedural draft resolution setting the date for debating article 1; this is order of work, not the article's content.
Separate vote on paragraph 1(c) of draft article 40 (inter-State communications), which maps to final ICCPR 41.
Sub-committee text on draft articles 5-7: arrest wording, the Nuremberg clause and the interpreter right. It spans UDHR 9-11 and none dominates.
Chair accepts the wording of draft article 14 on refuge from persecution and asylum, which maps to UDHR 14.
Roll-call vote on the second sentence of draft article 7 (medical experimentation), which is final ICCPR 7.
Romanian speech on draft article 9 (arbitrary arrest and detention) and its amendments, which is final ICCPR 9.
Vote on the USSR oral amendment to the French text on special protection of children within the family. Fits ICESCR 10; the article number is not stated.
Chair opens continued consideration of draft article 41 (ad hoc conciliation commission) and its amendments; maps to final ICCPR 42.
US view on the French paragraph on juvenile offenders proposed for draft article 13 (fair trial), which maps to final ICCPR 14.
Adoption of paragraph 1 of draft ICESCR article 18 (reports in stages under an ECOSOC programme), which maps to final ICESCR 17.

sonnet.reason: Chair puts a Saudi amendment changing a deadline in a procedural draft resolution about handling article 1; procedure, not the substance of self-determination.
Separate vote on a sentence of draft article 40, paragraph 1(c), on exhaustion of local remedies in inter-State communications; draft 40 maps to final ICCPR 41.
Sub-Committee report on arrest/trial articles; chair mostly relays accused's trial rights (Geneva art. 7 para 2, interpreter, documents), fitting fair hearing, though arrest wording also appears.
Under heading Article 14, the chair accepts the asylum wording (escape persecution by taking refuge); draft 14 maps to UDHR 14.
Chair puts the second sentence of draft article 7 (medical or scientific experimentation, torture) to a roll-call vote; draft 7 maps to final ICCPR 7.
Heading and speech concern draft article 9 on arbitrary arrest and detention and amendments to it; maps to final ICCPR 9.
Vote on the USSR oral amendment to the French amendment on special protection of children and young persons within the family; draft art. 26 maps to ICESCR 10.
Chair opens consideration of draft article 41 (ad hoc conciliation commission) and its amendments; draft 41 maps to final ICCPR 42.
Chair comments on the French proposal for special protection of juvenile offenders inserted into draft article 13 (fair trial); draft 13 maps to final ICCPR 14.
Vote adopting paragraph 1 of draft ICESCR article 18 (ECOSOC programme for reporting in stages) as amended; draft 18 maps to final ICESCR 17.

third.reason: Chair comments on the Sub-Committee's combined text of draft articles 5-7 (arrest, trial, Nuremberg clause, interpreter), which span UDHR 9, 10 and 11, with no one article dominating.

opus.reason: Chair puts draft article 4 (derogation) as a whole to the vote; draft 4 maps to ICCPR 4.
Roll-call votes on USSR amendment on science to draft article 25, which maps to UDHR 27.
Votes on French and US amendments to draft article 5 (capital punishment); draft 5 maps to ICCPR 6.
'It was so decided' records a decision on the order of work (which articles to take up next).
Chair notes implementation articles will be renumbered later; procedural, no single article.
Attendance list and agenda heading (French draft resolution, reservations proposals); procedural, no final article.
Adoption of US amendment to paragraph 1(a) of draft article 11 (movement); maps to ICCPR 12.
Belgian amendment to appear as paragraph 3 of draft article 26, which maps to ICESCR 10.
Chair puts USSR amendment on science to Article 30 (cultural life) to vote; draft 30 maps to UDHR 27.
Chair comments on word 'opportunity' in draft article 20 (gaining living by work); maps to ICESCR 6.

sonnet.reason: Chair puts draft article 4 (derogation in emergencies, final ICCPR 4) to the vote as a whole, as amended.
Roll-call votes on the USSR amendment on science to draft article 25, which is final UDHR 27 (cultural life, science).
Votes on the French and US amendments on capital punishment in draft article 5, which is final ICCPR 6 (right to life).
'It was so decided' on the order of work (articles 1 and 2, preamble, then additional articles); procedural.
Chair notes the implementation articles will be renumbered by the Secretariat; procedural, no specific article.
Attendance list and agenda heading for proposals on reservations; no final article is the subject.
Vote on the amended US amendment to paragraph 1 of draft article 11 (freedom of movement), final ICCPR 12.
Chair says the adopted Belgian amendment becomes paragraph 3 of draft article 26 (family, mothers, children), final ICESCR 10.
Chair puts the USSR amendment on science to the vote under draft article 30, which is final UDHR 27.
Chair comments on the word 'opportunity' in draft article 20 (work freely accepted), final ICESCR 6, in the French/English text discussion.

opus.reason: Vote adopting the text of draft articles 17 and 18 (freedom of opinion and information); both map to UDHR 19.
Debate on 'nature and cause of the accusation', article 13 para 2(a); draft 13 maps to ICCPR 14 (fair trial).
Vote adopting article 15 as a whole; 1952 draft article 15 maps to ICCPR 21 (peaceful assembly).
Vote on the Chinese amendment to article 23; 1952 economic draft article 23 maps to ICESCR 11 (standard of living).
Vote on the Chilean proposal limiting speeches on points of order to five minutes: procedure.
Adopted text of draft article 2 on limits of rights and duties to society; maps to UDHR 29.
Chair records accepted wording on liberty of movement, residence and emigration: UDHR 13.
Chair opens draft article 14 (property) and reads government comments; maps to UDHR 17.
Attendance list and agenda heading of the meeting; no article content.
Chair opens discussion of covenant draft article 5 (deprivation of life); maps to ICCPR 6.

sonnet.reason: Vote adopting the Drafting Committee's text on draft articles 17 and 18 (freedom of opinion and information), which map to UDHR 19.
Chair on 'nature and cause of the accusation' in draft article 13, para 2(a); draft 13 maps to ICCPR 14.
Adoption of draft article 15 as a whole, with its restriction clause amendments; draft 15 maps to ICCPR 21 (assembly).
Vote on the Chinese amendment to ICESCR draft article 23, which maps to final ICESCR 11.
Vote on a time limit for speeches on points of order and explanations of vote; pure procedure.
Adoption of draft Article 2 (limited by rights of others, individual owes duties to society), mapped to UDHR 29.
Chair's accepted wording on liberty of movement, free choice of residence and emigration; draft article 13 maps to UDHR 13.
Chair introduces draft article 14 (ownership of property) with government comments; draft 14 maps to UDHR 17.
Attendance list and agenda title block; no discussion of any article, though the meeting continues article 17.
Chair opens discussion of draft article 5 (right to life) and calls for amendments; draft 5 maps to ICCPR 6.

opus.reason: Vote on the second Brazil-Philippine amendment, between the votes on paragraphs 1 and 2 of draft article 18 (religion), which maps to final ICCPR 18.
The chair opens draft ICESCR article 18 and lists its amendments; it maps to final ICESCR 17 (reporting in stages).
The chair's reminder that colonialism is not under discussion is a procedural call to relevance, not about the minorities article's content.
Rejects the Byelorussian deletion of the examinations sentence in the public employment/office article; that subject is UDHR 21(2), but no number is shown.
The chair puts the second USSR amendment to paragraph 2 of draft article 11 (movement) to the vote; it maps to UDHR 13.
Under the Article 35 heading (education), the chair accepts a rewording and explains why 'adults' is there; draft 35 maps to UDHR 26.
Vote on the third sentence of the French amendment to paragraph 1 of draft article 23 (technical education); maps to UDHR 26.
Adoption of draft article 22 (social protection of children born out of wedlock); it maps to UDHR 25.
Votes on the Chilean amendment to Convention Article 15 (freedom of religion and belief) and on that article; it corresponds to ICCPR 18.
The chair puts amended draft article 19 (will of the people, paragraph 3) to the vote; it maps to UDHR 21.

sonnet.reason: Vote on the second Brazilian/Philippine amendment during the vote on draft article 18 (freedom of thought, conscience and religion); draft 18 maps to ICCPR 18.
Chair opens consideration of draft ICESCR article 18 and its amendments (schedule or programme of reports); the numbering maps draft 18 to final ICESCR 17.
Chair's procedural reminder that colonialism is not under discussion; call to order, not about the minorities article's content.
Vote on the Byelorussian amendment to delete the examinations sentence of the public employment and office article; draft articles 26-28 map to UDHR 21.
Chair puts the second USSR amendment to paragraph 2 of draft article 11 (freedom of movement) to the vote; draft 11 maps to UDHR 13.
Chair accepts alternative wording and explains the word 'adults' in the education article (draft 35, under heading Article 35), which maps to UDHR 26.
Chair puts the sentence on technical and professional education to the vote in draft article 23 (education), which maps to UDHR 26.
Adoption of draft article 22 under its heading (Norway on protection of children born out of wedlock); draft 22 maps to UDHR 25.
Votes on Chilean amendment and the whole of Convention Article 15 (religion and belief, paragraph 3 limits); the Convention's freedom of religion article became ICCPR 18, not the Declaration.
Chair puts draft article 19, as amended (will of the people as basis of government authority), to the vote; draft 19 maps to UDHR 21.
